title: 3_7_A_Fallon_Family_Christmas

labels: Pull Arinna out of the way!

nodes.text: Denni turns to the two men.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So you two don't agree on the method... But the intent is the same.
Mal and Mitch trade looks. Then Mitch sighs.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Look, Mal, maybe we can agree to disagree. You heard something, and you didn't hesitate to confront danger for everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I can respect that at least.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I'm sorry I mistook you for a thief. Maybe the job does make me a little twitchy. But I do honestly believe I help people more than I harm them.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I understand.
They shake hands.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: So tell me one thing... Why are you even dressed as Santa in the first place? Maddie's asleep.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I was going to visit her as Santa to give her a doll she said she'd wanted. I might do that before we go to bed.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Not to mention that there's a gingerbread cookie she's set out with my name on it.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Santa's privileges.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Well, now that that's over. Let's head to bed.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Good night, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Night!
It's Christmas morning!
The household awakens to the delightful sounds of Christmas carols and...

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Hey! Hey, everyone! Santa came! He really came, and he gave me a doll!
Maddie runs downstairs into the living room to find everyone else grabbing plates for breakfast.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Colt, did you see my doll?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I definitely heard about it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Santa dropped by, huh?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: He did! He really did! I dreamed about him giving me a gift last night, and I thought it was a dream, but it was really him! The doll was here when I woke up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's wonderful!

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Is everyone else ready for presents?
And for the next hour, everyone hands out gifts and cards, laughing merrily and sipping apple cider.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks, Mal and Natara for the photos... And thanks, Mom, for the camera lens! This is so amazing!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Yeah, Mom, thanks for my gift too. The poetry workshop you got for me is going to make my art so much better.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I know my daughters.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey Denni, I got something for you...
Denni opens a small box where a metallic pendant sits attached to a sleek black ribbon.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt... This is beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's a pendant made from the motorcycle I wrecked when we were in that helicopter chase.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...In a video game?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee... Thank you.
And over on the other side of the tree...

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Mal, Natara... Here are gifts for you.
Mal and Natara unwrap their gifts.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: An apron?

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Yes, cooking together is sign of true love. Don't worry, I got Mal something else to match...
Mal pulls out another frilly matching apron.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You shouldn't have.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Don't wear them out.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: We got something for you too, Mitch.
Natara plucks a package out from underneath the tree, extending it to Mitch.
Mitch opens it to reveal a reindeer sweater. He turns it over... And smiles.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: It's great.
He says it with such genuine gratitude that Mal is stunned.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Yes. Reindeer sweaters, crackling fires in the fireplace, families by the Christmas tree... It all says Christmas to him.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Right on the money, as usual.
Suddenly, Mitch stands up.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Everyone, over here... I'd like to make a toast.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Oh dear.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Christmas is about being around people you love. And this Christmas, we are lucky to have so many people around.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I just want to say thank you for being in Cynthia's life... And also my own. We hope we see you all again next year.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Hear hear.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Merry Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Merry Christmas, everyone!
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 7: A Fallon Family Christmas.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 3, Episode 7: A Fallon Family Christmas.[/b]

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do now?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do now?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: We're not `fighting,` Denni.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not [color=#e23b3b][i]fighting,[/i][/color] Denni.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: No, not at all.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It sure sounds an awful lot like it.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Fighting or not, we should settle this tonight.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Natara's right. Going to bed angry is not the way to do it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So who's right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Both of them! They're on the same side.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe Mal shouldn't have attacked Mitch without figuring out who it was first...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And maybe Mitch could have explained himself before it went too far...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But at the heart of all of it...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Both of you are on the same side because both of you were doing it to take care of family.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Well put, sweetheart.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's rather poetic.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Merry Freaking Christmas!
Suddenly Mal can hear a lot of commotion around him.
The lights flick on. Everyone except for Maddie is standing in the vestibule, staring at Mal.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Mal, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And why is Mitch on the ground, trussed up like a turkey?
Mal looks over, realizing that the intruder tied up in the Christmas wreath is Mitch dressed as Santa.
The 'weapon' in his hands is actually an oversized candy cane.
Mitch stares up furiously at Mal, struggling against his constraints.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Whoops.
You are now playing as Denni.
In the dining room, everyone except for Maddie is sitting with a cup of tea or cocoa. A newly freed Mitch scowls at the head of the table, while Mal frowns next to him.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So what exactly happened?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I heard a sound, and concerned about my family's safety, I went to check it out.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Then he found me, and the next thing I know, I'm in a wreath!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh... Man, that was funny.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not the time, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You should have said something. I couldn't have known it was you.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: This is `my` house! I thought `you` were the intruder. This is just the kind of thing I was talking about, Cynthia.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] house! I thought [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] were the intruder. This is just the kind of thing I was talking about, Cynthia.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I'm sure it wasn't--

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Yes, it was. Mal's reaction was way out of proportion.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Out of proportion? I don't think so.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You know, if it had actually been a burglar instead of a man parading around as Santa Claus, this conversation would be entirely different.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: We're in a very safe neighborhood.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Oh, please, do you have `any` idea how often I hear that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, please, do you have [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] idea how often I hear that?

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: You could have tried to get more information before attacking me.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: What if it hadn't been me? What if it had been Raven, Denni, or Maddie? Someone could have been hurt.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: And it's just this kind of thing that makes your line of work a danger to the family.
Denni stands up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mal! Mitch!
They both look to her.
Mal jerks the wreath off the wall and crowns it over the intruder's head, sliding it down to pin his arms!
Mal yanks the garland off the wall and throws it over the figure... But it bounces ineffectively off him!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Well, that was ill-conceived.
The intruder gets to his feet and charges at Mal!
Mal freezes.
In his moment of hesitation, the intruder gets back onto his feet and starts charging straight at Mal!
On the wall nearby hangs a Christmas wreath and a silver and gold garland.
Mal reaches for...
Mal grabs the poinsettia plant and hefts it at the figure.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Hf!
It hits the intruder in the leg, and he goes down.
Mal hurls the stocking at the intruder, but it's not heavy enough to make it!
It falls short, and stocking stuffers spill all over the intruder's feet! Mal is suddenly thwacked hard in the gut by the weapon!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: `Ooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The intruder takes another swing at Mal with all his might!
Mal ignores the burst of pain in his stomach from the previous strike and dodges the attack, rolling to his feet. The intruder's momentum carries him to the floor!
Mal grabs nothing and gets hit in the side!
The shadowy figure turns to Mal again, tightening his grip on his weapon.
Mal looks around desperately for something to throw, and spots a poinsettia plant in a planter on the mantle and some stockings full of gifts...
Mal ducks, hearing the whoosh of the weapon above him. Then he dives forward, finding himself near the fireplace!
Mal jumps to the side, but he's still in the path of the weapon! It strikes him in the gut!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Hkk...
Luckily, it doesn't hurt too much, and Mal dives away from a second swing, finding himself near the fireplace.
Uncertain what to do, Mal freezes and gets hit in the gut by the weapon!
On the ground, Mal and the intruder struggle for the upper hand. Mal tries to strike him, but it's so dark that he misses!
Instead, the other guy elbows him hard in the chest, pushing Mal off him!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Oof!
Mal scrambles to his feet as the stranger rolls away from him and stands up shakily. With his weapon out in front, he swings!
Mal tackles the shadowy figure, and they topple straight into a large pile of presents piled near the tree!
Smaller gifts and shiny pieces of wrapping paper fly through the air.
Mal freezes, unsure what to do!
He takes a tentative step forward and brushes a Christmas decoration, disturbing a trio of bells on the wall.
At the sound, the figure looks in Mal's direction and slowly raises his weapon...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Crap!
Mal runs forward and takes him down, sending them flying backwards!
Elsewhere, Natara helps Raven and Mitch build a fire.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: ...If you start with really dry kindling beforehand, it's easier to spark a flame.
Natara stokes the embers, and soon a small fire burns pleasantly in the hearth.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Wow, you're so fast.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It usually takes Mitch here at least twenty more minutes.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Making a fire is an art... That Natara has clearly mastered.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Hee.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: This is perfect. A fire burning, family all around. It makes a guy feel warm inside. That's what really matters in this world.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: And Natara, how are you so good at this? I'm all butterfingers next to you.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I've had some practice. My father was very keen on all his children learning how to survive in the wilderness.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Did it work?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Well, I turned out okay, but my little sister probably couldn't survive in the wild with a tent, two months of pre-made food, and a GPS!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I know the feeling...
Across the room, Denni turns and pouts...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey! I'm plenty resourceful!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You once got lost in your own backyard!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It was dark!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: So what's next?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Next, we set out presents under the tree...
Maddie wanders up to them.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Presents? Are there going to be presents?

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Of course. And after Santa visits, there's going to be more tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Santa's never come to my house before...
Natara, Raven, and Mitch share a sad look.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Maybe Santa doesn't know your address, Maddie. But Santa always comes to this house.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: And if you're really good, he'll visit tonight...
And in another corner of the room, Cynthia puts gumdrops on gingerbread cookies while Mal eats them.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I haven't had a gingerbread cookie since... Since our last Christmas with Mom.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I try to make them every year. They remind me of her. In a good way.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Is that how we're going to do to remember Dad?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Nah. He hated gingerbread. If you'd like, I could steal all the chocolates out of the advent calendar.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I can't believe he's really gone.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Me neither.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: It's funny. He wasn't there for most of my life. He didn't even see Mitch's and my wedding. And I never took the kids to visit him.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: So I thought I was past the point of missing him.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: But now that I know he's gone, that I'll never see him again, I miss him more than ever. I just wish I knew he'd cared.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: He did care about you in the end. He always felt bad about how things were with you two.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I was wondering why you accepted my invitation this year.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: It's not just that. Seeing Dad go made me realize how little time we have. I want to see you more. We're all we have left.
Cynthia puts an arm around you and squeezes affectionately.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: You're right. And you should visit more often. I wouldn't mind seeing more of you.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: And hey, if your older sister's opinion matters... I like Natara. I'm sure Mom would have too.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Thanks.
You are now playing as Mal Fallon.
It's nearly one in the morning, and everyone is in their beds.
Mal and Natara sleep soundly in a bedroom on the second floor when Mal suddenly hears a loud 'thud' from the hallway outside.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: What the...?
Mal sneaks out of bed, edging towards the door. He opens it quietly and stares into the darkness.
A huge, shadowy figure creeps down the stairs, a large bag in one hand and what looks to be a crowbar in the other.
Mal follows him down the hall and down the stairs to the living room.
Despite the Christmas lights, it's still difficult to see. Mal can only make out the figure stealing one of the gifts and putting it into a giant bag!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Oh no you don't...
Mal shoots forward to...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually, I don't know that saying.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's the family you're born with, your father and Maddie...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And then there's the family you choose...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I'm here whenever you and Maddie need me.
Colt smiles, brushes her hair out of her face, and kisses her tenderly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thank you. And merry Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe for your family. Mitch tells lame jokes, but he loves you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For my family... It doesn't even come close.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My dad doesn't care what my sister and I do. And I could care less what he does with his life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As far as I'm concerned, it's just me and Maddie.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And where do I fit in?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're important too.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're important to me too, Colt. And I want you to know that I'm always here for you and Maddie. Whenever you need me.
Colt leans over and kisses her tenderly.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Regardless, I still don't think you should pursue law enforcement. It doesn't seem like a good career for a young man with a lot of potential.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Actually, a guy like Colt could benefit a lot from the discipline and challenge in the field.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: And what about the violence and the danger in the job?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You mean, the part where they risk their lives to keep the rest of us safe?

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Not you too, Raven!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I'm just saying, we should be thanking them, not criticizing them!

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: And I'm just saying, I recently heard from Cynthia that Mal was threatened by dangerous and powerful people.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: What's to stop them from making it even more personal by going after family?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: That was kind of a... Special situation. It's not like I'm in a dangerous situation every week.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Well, it sometimes seems that way!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Mitch, I know that it can seem intimidating from an outside perspective... But you have to understand that law enforcement is a calling.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I could have chosen to follow my father into business. Believe me, it would have made him happy.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: But some part of me knew I'd never be happy with myself unless I was out there, helping people, saving lives... Doing the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Well said.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: You two made your choices. And that's fine.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: But I can't tell Colt to do the same and endanger his life and potentially my step-daughter's.
A silence falls over the group. Colt clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I'm, uh... Still deciding.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Good, Colt. Follow your heart, but do consider all your options.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Now... Who's up for gingerbread cookies and putting up the decorations on the tree?
In the den...
Everyone drinks hot chocolate and eats gingerbread cookies while putting the finishing touches on an unadorned tree.
To one side, Colt, Denni, and Maddie are stringing kernels of popcorn together to make a garland for the tree.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm surprised that Mitch didn't give this tree a makeover when he had the chance. Why make us do it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He likes it when the tree represents the entire family, so we put it together on Christmas Eve.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I really like the tradition.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Me too! It's fun!
Colt threads another kernel onto their string while Maddie stuffs a whole bunch of popcorn into her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You just like popcorn.
She smiles a smile flecked with popcorn, making Denni and Colt laugh.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you not like Christmas decorating?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's not that. I'm just not used to it. My dad's not exactly the 'holiday-spirit' type.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually, he's a total deadbeat. He doesn't do jack--
Denni frowns, tilting her head at Maddie, who's absently staring at a crystal ornament.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: --Frost. For Christmas or anything. Right now, he's out on the town, celebrating Christmas with himself. He doesn't even want to come home. Worst family ever.
Denni puts her popcorn garland down to hug him.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know that saying...

options.label: There's family you have and family you choose.
Family is the most important thing in the world.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: The casework?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know, studying the evidence, making inquires, using deductive logic...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's pretty much the only time I've wanted to study anything.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I suppose good police-work requires a good head. Which you have.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Interest and the desire to do well are both good places to start.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: The action?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, stopping bad guys, getting into chases, taking people down... He'd be real good at that stuff!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I am `really` good at taking people down.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] good at taking people down.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Yeah, well, that's not really what being a cop is all about...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: It's also not very realistic. I hope that's not the only reason you'd want to join the police force.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! Of course not! He's really serious about it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm also interested in the other side of it. Filing boring paperwork and stuff seems fun too...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It makes dinner awkward. That's probably why Mal hasn't visited us the last few years.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, I forgot to mention... Thanks for inviting me and Maddie over to eat dinner and stay the night.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My dad likes to celebrate Christmas alone, so your invitation, uh, means a lot to us.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course! You know my mom loves having Maddie around. And Mitch has totally warmed up to you since you started paying attention in school.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Don't remind me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hard to believe that a year ago, I was in San Francisco trying to find myself. I can't believe I was so lost back then.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How are you feeling now?
He takes her hand.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Less clueless than before.
Denni leans up to kiss him tenderly.
And that's when they hear a honk from the driveway! Denni pulls away and runs to the door.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Mom, Raven, Mitch! Mal's here!
The door swings open, and a tall, scruffy man steps inside...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Hey there! Where's that niece of mine?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uncle Mal!
Denni runs over and grabs her uncle in a big hug! A serious, beautiful woman steps in after him...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I'm guessing this is your niece?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Sure is. Denni, meet Agent Natara Williams. Natara, meet my niece Denni!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's nice to meet you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, good to see you again, Agent Hotstuff!
Everyone turns to stare at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean... Uh... Who wants turkey?
Just as Denni is about to punch Colt in the arm, she hears some commotion on the stairs behind her. Her big sister, Raven, runs down, followed by her mom and stepdad.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Hey there, Raven! How's college treating you?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's going great. I'm taking criminology actually... And I think I might be learning about some of your cases!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: That's... Super creepy.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Natara, meet Raven, my other niece. And over there is my sister Cynthia and her husband Mitch.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Hi...

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... Seriously... Turkey-time?
After several introductions, the entire party sits down at the dinner table. Mitch carves the turkey, serving Maddie first.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: I've never seen turkey that didn't come out of a plastic box before! Colt, you never make this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Trust me, kid, you don't want to see how I cook turkey.
Everyone laughs. Mitch hands out turkey and tofu turkey slices to everyone.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: So, Natara, it's so nice to finally meet you.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I don't talk to my little brother often, but whenever I do, he always mentions you.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: That's very sweet of him.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: It's nice to meet you too, Cynthia. I'm dying to know more about what Mal was like as a kid.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I don't even know where to begin. Mal used to get in trouble all the time. Like the bottle rockets at the circus incident...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Bottle rockets?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Circus?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I don't want to think anyone's interested in hearing that... And if I remember right, the ending doesn't make for great dinner conversation...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Especially if you're a giraffe...

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Fine, but I'm telling it later over hot chocolate.
Mal shakes his head. Natara leans over and gives him a little kiss on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa! Did I just see what I thought I saw?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Did you `finally` ask her out, Mal? Way to go, bro!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you [color=#e23b3b][i]finally[/i][/color] ask her out, Mal? Way to go, bro!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Please don't call me that...

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Well, apparently I'm in the dark here... How did you two crazy kids get together?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I don't think I've heard `this` story...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think I've heard [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] story...

nodes.text: Natara and Mal exchange glances.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: There was this `jungle`...
nodes.text_bbcode: There was this [color=#e23b3b][i]jungle[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: That was later. We first met during the Maskmaker case.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: After that case closed, Mal and I worked on several more investigations together.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: A workplace romance, huh? What would a lady like you be doing working with the police?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I'm a profiler with the FBI.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Oh yeah? I'm in the FBI too...

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: The Federal Bureau of `Indigestion!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The Federal Bureau of [color=#e23b3b][i]Indigestion![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Seriously, these mashed potatoes are not sitting well.
Cynthia and Natara chuckle while Denni and Raven groan.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mitch, that was awful...

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Cynthia liked it, and she's the most important audience member.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Fair enough. Well, Natara, I hope you're keeping Mal out of trouble.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Not as much as I'd like, unfortunately.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Enough about us. How are you guys doing?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Good! Mitch and I are making plans for a vacation to New York.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Flying or driving?

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Flying, of course. Though my arms are probably going to get tired.
Mitch guffaws, and Cynthia pats his arm.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: We might also be stopping in Chicago in the middle. To give your arms a rest.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: ...Exciting. So, Denni, how's school?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great! Good for me. The journalism club is doing some interesting projects this year that I'm a major part of. It'll look great on my college application.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And Colt here is doing well. His grades are up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Actually, I had a question to ask you and Natara. Colt's graduating from high school soon, and he's interested in going into law enforcement.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Copy that, dispatch.
Mitch frowns.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Is that really what you want, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've been thinking about it ever since I came back from San Francisco. I want to try.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I admire the civic impulse... But you do know being a law enforcement officer is tremendous work.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I know, I know. I just think I'd be good at it, you know? I've got a good feeling in my gut.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I respect that!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Of course you do.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: This is all well and good... But is law enforcement for Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: From what I've seen and read about, I bet I'd like it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, Colt is interested in the...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mal? Come on, the guy's a hero.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He bailed me out of a bad situation when I was in San Francisco.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And he's the one who inspired me to tell you how I feel.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He's not a bad guy. I can't believe anyone would think he's a bad influence.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You might not. But Mitch does.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you talking about? It's awesome!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, we think so. But for some people, all that talk about crazy criminals and freaky chases... It can be a bit much.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All I know is that Mitch doesn't like it when Uncle Mal starts telling stories about apprehending felons and questioning suspects.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think it creeps him out.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So Denni, got any fun plans?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes. My stepdad Mitch usually goes all out. He decorates the entire house in wreaths and reindeer and lights!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I have to endure a lot of Christmas puns...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But other than that, it's a lot of fun. And this year, we're kind of having a family reunion.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: My big sister Raven is coming home from college, and my Uncle Mal is driving in from San Francisco just to visit us!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who's Uncle Mal?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's a famous detective in his district, and he's put a lot of famous villains away. Have you heard of the 'Maskmaker'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wasn't that a movie or something?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's about a case that my uncle and his partner Natara solved!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They're pretty cool... I actually worked a case with them, back when I was doing that whole `drive around California and find myself` thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: They're pretty cool... I actually worked a case with them, back when I was doing that whole [color=#e23b3b][i]drive around California and find myself[/i][/color] thing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You 'worked a case' with some cops?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's a crazy story.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds like so much fun! It almost makes me want to go to your house for Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, really.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know, right?
At that moment, the bell rings. All the students hastily turn in their worksheets and pack up their bags.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Merry Christmas, you guys!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You too!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See ya!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Happy holidays!
They quickly rush out into the halls, towards home.
You are now playing as Denni.
It's the afternoon of Christmas Eve, and she stands in front of a large window overlooking the front of the house.
The lawn outside and the driveway are completely covered in Christmas decorations.
Fake snow and layers of multi-colored lights cover the roof and bushes, and an inflatable Santa sits atop a life-sized sleigh with eight reindeer posing in front.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wow, you really weren't kidding about Mitch and the decorations. It's like Christmas threw up everywhere.
Denni turns, as Colt slides an arm around her shoulder. She shoots him a look.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Colt.` That's gross.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Colt.[/i][/color] That's gross.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think there's a nice ring to it... A certain `poetry.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think there's a nice ring to it... A certain [color=#e23b3b][i]poetry.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Poetry. Right. You're a regular modern-day Shakespeare.
Colt kisses her on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Just try to clean up your language, okay? At least for your sister's sake?
Denni nods to a corner where his sister Maddie, is playing with toys.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Trust me, she's heard worse.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So why are you staring out the window?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uncle Mal texted me, saying that he and Natara would be here soon. I wanted to greet him, so I came out here. But no sign yet.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't wait to see him! He rarely visits us.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really? Why? When I hung out with him in San Francisco, he seemed pretty fond of you guys.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's really busy. But also I don't think he and my stepdad get along very well.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really? The 'I'm so generous I baked you a week's worth of dinners' Mitch? That guy doesn't hate anyone.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's not 'hate'. It's just about being friendly. Mitch doesn't like that Uncle Mal's a detective.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why not? It's pretty much the coolest thing ever!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe it's because what Uncle Mal does is...

nodes.prompt: Maybe it's because what Uncle Mal does is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Maybe it's because what Uncle Mal does is...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, $ZOE, but that's pretty much exactly what that means.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You guys aren't together, so you don't get to see each other.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Besides, when you do see an ex, you start playing the 'break-up battle.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'The break-up battle'?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's just where you start comparing your lives to one another. Which one of you is better off after the break-up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't do that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everyone does it. You'll wonder if he's dated anyone, and that'll make you feel bad if you're `not` dating anyone...
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone does it. You'll wonder if he's dated anyone, and that'll make you feel bad if you're [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] dating anyone...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or maybe you find out he's getting better grades... Then you feel bad because maybe your grades aren't as good. And then you wonder, are you more affected by your breakup than he is?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, you guys are sad after break-ups. If Denni and I ever broke up, I'd be making out with all kinds of hotties!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `...Ahem.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Ahem.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Er, I mean, making all kinds of... Hot teas? Because dumb, sad people drink hot tea, right? That's a thing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It might be a bad idea, but I still want to see him. Even if it's just for a couple of minutes...
Ben and Denni shrug.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know we're not going to get back together, but I still want to see him happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I used to be pretty close to his mother and his younger twin sisters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't see the harm in stopping by for a few minutes.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess as long as you're stopping by as a friend of the family and not as Howard's ex, it's less weird.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That makes sense.
$ZOE loses her train of thought.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... It, uh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't mean that I can't see him.
You are now playing as $ZOE.
It's the last period on the Friday before the winter holiday, and the classroom buzzes with excitement over the impending vacation.
In one corner of the room, Ben, Denni, Colt, and $ZOE work together on an easy assignment.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right. I got the answer for the last question. It's $425. That's your principal after you pay back the interest on your loans.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: People pay back their loans?
But he writes the answer down.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh man, am I glad that Mrs. Fitzpootie is just letting us do this easy worksheet for the last ten minutes of class.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All I can think about right now is Christmas and gingerbread cookies.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Forget cookies. Give me `two weeks` off school any day.
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget cookies. Give me [color=#e23b3b][i]two weeks[/i][/color] off school any day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you guys doing with your time off? Anything extravagant?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hear Paige is going to a fancy ski resort for the holidays. I wonder if she invited anyone else...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pfft. Who wants to go to some fancy-pants resort? Could anything be more boring?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm doing Christmas with Denni's family, but other than that, I'm sleeping in, playing pool, and taking long trips on my motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about you, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spending time with Emily. I've got a week with her before her family goes on their winter trip.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And then after that, I've enrolled in a basketball camp.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Is, uh, is Owen going with you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yep. It was his and Spencer's idea to go along with it. What are you doing, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Traditional Christmas stuff. Dinner with the family. I, uh, I heard that Howard's coming back into town for his break.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're still in contact with Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not... Really. My aunt ran into Howard's mom at some PTA meeting. I was thinking of trying to see him.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's probably a bad idea anyway. Seeing an ex only a couple months after your breakup is never good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, just because we're broken up doesn't mean...
Suddenly, you hear a loud crashing sound!
The snow whirls around you and then disappears!
The room melts back to normal...
The door bursts open, and you see a giant white lizard with Beastmaster Kimuko on its back!

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Hello, students. Sorry for the delay in getting to you, but I had to request a `B'Lizard` from our Alaskan sister-school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello, students. Sorry for the delay in getting to you, but I had to request a [color=#3b78e2][i]B'Lizard[/i][/color] from our Alaskan sister-school.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: A B'Lizard?

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Also known as a Blizzard-Lizard. These dragon beasts control snow and frost... Which makes them perfect for cleaning up messes like this.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: As long as you can control them.
Kimuko jerks the reigns of the B'Lizard back, and the dragon gives a screech.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Now, if I'm not mistaken, I believe Headmaster Cromwell wants a word with the three of you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, I was afraid of that.
Later, at Headmaster Cromwell's office, after an hour of explaining...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I assume it goes without saying that you're all lucky to be alive.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Headmaster. It was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It was more than that. It was the ghost of Lorenna Lune.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Lorenna Lune? Who's that?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: She's part of a very sad chapter in the school's history...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But one that, thanks to the three of you, we can now close.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You see, Lorenna Lune did indeed live in your very room, $CADY. That was why she could change the space. The room remembered her.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Um, yeah, that's not creepy at all.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: She was a bit of an outcast, I'm sad to say. No friends, and sadly no family.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: She had nowhere to go for the holiday break, so she stayed on campus...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: She was alone, but she was so quiet that no one realized the strain the isolation had on her.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: One day she disappeared, and we never found a trace of her...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Until now.
Cromwell holds up the snow globe.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It's beginning to make sense. We searched the areas of the school where a student might get lost. We searched her belongings.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I was sure we'd checked every possibility. Simon, you said you took the snow globe from the 'Lost and Found'... We never thought to search the 'Lost and Found' for traces of her or her magic.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: We never thought to examine this snow globe.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: We wouldn't have thought it had anything to do with her disappearance.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You see, this snow globe has been in the 'Lost and Found' for years... From before Lorenna even came to SpellClaive.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Lorenna was obsessed with magical artifacts. She must have come across this magical snow globe in the 'Lost and Found' just as Simon did...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I can imagine how entranced she would have been by it. A perfect little world...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And she must have found a way `in`, but not a way `out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And she must have found a way [color=#3b78e2][i]in[/i][/color], but not a way [color=#3b78e2][i]out.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yikes.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Yikes indeed, Simon.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Mixing spells is always hazardous at best and disastrous at worst. You're lucky your duplication spell didn't end up with something much more terrible!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yes, Ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And poor Lorenna... Always so alone... And then to be trapped in that snow globe, so isolated...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: She's free now.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That's something, yes. I'm glad she's finally at rest.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Well. I'm glad the three of you are safe as well. And that you have each other.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: We're quite fortunate!
And so...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And then I use the gumdrops to give them tiny clothing?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Exactly! And then you eat 'em.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Mmm! What delicious human effigies! These 'gingerbread cookies' are delightful!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Um... Thanks. I know it's kind of silly, but that's part of the fun.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, I am beginning to understand. How are you doing with the entrails?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, it's pretty hard to tell when they're fully drained, but I think I've got it.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Excellent! To the pool of blood!
Simon pops his head through the open door and watches while Arinna snacks on a gingerbread cookie and Cady wrestles with the offering.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Ah, nothing quite like the holidays.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Hey, can I help?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon! It is good of you to come! These tiny men need decorating and also eating.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And when that's done, I'm sure we can find something entrails-related for you to help with.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Good to see you're embracing Rig'Rhallan.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You know, entrails really don't seem that horrifying when you've already faced down a ghost...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Well. And I guess nothing says 'happy Rig'Rhallan' like entrails.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You would not wish one a 'happy' Rig'Rhallan. Perhaps a safe Rig'Rhallan, or a fearful Rig'Rhallan...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, then, a fearful Rig'Rhallan to you, Arinna.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And happiest of holidays to you, $CADY.
And happy holidays to `you` too!
nodes.text_bbcode: And happy holidays to [b]you[/b] too!

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `The Christmas Curse!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]The Christmas Curse![/b]

nodes.text: You reach out and put the snow globe in the girl's outstretched hand.
As you do, a crack slowly appears, and dark shadows flow out of it, surrounding the girl.

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: Thank you.
The girl wavers in front of your eyes, and then the shadows begin to change, growing lighter and lighter...
As the girl vanishes, the snow globe falls almost in slow motion to the ground, coming to rest gently in the spot where she stood.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That was...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Just wow.
Slowly, the room returns to normal...
You have failed.

nodes.text: You pull back and throw the snow globe at the ground as hard as you can!
It shatters in an explosion of glass.

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: `NOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]NOO![/i]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I don't think she's happy...
The girl raises her hands up, and ice and snow begin pouring from her fingertips.

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: `YOU! YOU DESTROYED IT! MY PERFECT WORLD!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]YOU! YOU DESTROYED IT! MY PERFECT WORLD![/i]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: This... Doesn't look good.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Eek!
A blast of snow and ice hits you! You go down, and everything fades away in a wash of white.
You tentatively step forward...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Um... I think this is yours...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No, this is weird even for our standards.
As you watch, the girl raises her hands, and the snow globes come flying to her from the other room.

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: Skreeeee!
The ghost screeches, and the snow globes all shatter!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I guess she really hates snow globes...
The ghost turns chilling eyes on Arinna...
The girl takes a step towards Arinna!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No! Ignis... Confla...
The girl glares at Simon and waves a hand in his direction.

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: You dare...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Urk!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I've got to help him! He was trying to cast the fire spell... Let's see if I can do it.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: Hiss!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Be cool, $CADY!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, please calm yourself!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sorry, guys.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But this isn't, like, normal here... Is it?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay... Stay calm, $CADY. Just a creepy ghost girl... No reason to panic.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, we can handle this.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: We can?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yes! Are we magicians, or aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: But this is not a normal situation here, is it?
There's a second of calm, and then an avalanche of snow slams down around the room!
Everything goes white...
Some time later, you open your eyes and... Everything is still white.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY! Can you hear me?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Unnh... Arinna? It's so c-c-cold! Where are you? I'm totally stuck!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: We are all stuck. And freezing.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What are we going to do?!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh, $CADY. So young and new to magic. There's no need to fret. Magic got us into this, and magic will get us out!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Turo... Diem... Vash!
There's a rumbling, and suddenly the snow in the room doubles! You feel it pressing down even harder on you!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Simon! You're going to bury us alive! Stop it!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Maybe there's something more complicated going on here...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Maybe a more direct approach.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: If we can't make it vanish, maybe we can at least melt some of it.
From somewhere nearby, you can hear Simon casting...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: $CADY, you know the spell, right? Can you help me?

nodes.text: No problem. I learned this one my first day.

Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: My thanks, $CADY.
You dive out of the way. The boxes crash down on top of Arinna!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Ouch!
You freeze!
The boxes crash down on top of you and Arinna!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Owww...
Just then, there's a knock at the door. You open it to find your friend, Simon!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Hello, ladies!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That's... An interesting smell.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That's the entrails...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon! It is good to see you on this most festive day!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I've come with gifts for each of you!
Simon reaches into his backpack and pulls out a red package wrapped with a gold bow.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Christmas presents? You shouldn't have...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I mean that. Depending on what you put in that box, you probably shouldn't have...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: You're going to love these. Here, Arinna. Merry Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh, my first gift of Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I did not realize we were participating in a ritual of exchange... I... I...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's okay! You don't need to get me anything! To be honest, I got a really great deal on this gift.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Go on! Open it!
Arinna rips open the present and pulls out an ornate, old-fashioned snow globe! The base is carved in wood with intricate engravings.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: A tiny world! With a tiny girl inside!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It's a snow globe!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: And not just any snow globe... Try shaking it!
Arinna gently shakes the snow globe and watches in amazement as snow begins to cascade down inside the globe...
And then little flakes of snow begin falling all around Arinna!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It's snowing!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's an `enchanted` snow globe! When you shake it, real snow falls wherever you are!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's an [color=#e23b3b][i]enchanted[/i][/color] snow globe! When you shake it, real snow falls wherever you are!

nodes.text: Arinna gives the snow globe another shake and then extends her arms in the falling snow, twirling around as the flakes drift down.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: What a beautiful gift!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So cool!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I'm glad you like it, $CADY... Because I kind of got you the same thing.
Simon hands you an identical red package with a gold bow, and you tear into it.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Bulk discount, huh?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, thanks, Simon.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So, who else did you get snow globes for?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Huh? No one else.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Then what's with the matching boxes in your bag?
You point to Simon's backpack, which is stuffed to the brim with red boxes topped with gold bows.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: What? I... I didn't...
As you watch, another box pops into existence, followed by another, then another.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I... Uh... May have used a duplication spell on the snow globe...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So by 'really good deal' you meant...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I found it in SpellClaive's 'Lost and Found' and duplicated it using magic!
There's a brief sparkling, and then suddenly twice as many boxes are in Simon's bag!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: The magic of the snow globe seems to be reacting poorly to the duplication spell...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Well, it did take a few tries before I was able to get it to duplicate...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Watch out!
The number of boxes double, then double again and again, filling up the room!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but you've got to tell a professor about this.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Priam said a few faculty members stayed here to keep an eye on the students for the holidays... And I think the headmistress is probably still here.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Great... That's exactly the person I want to tell about this...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hey, at least you'll get credit for bringing it to her attention right away.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That's true. Okay, I'll just go...
As Simon reaches for the door, the pile of boxes expands, blocking him! He tries to push them aside and...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh no... Oh no! They're going to fall!
The boxes tilt towards you and Arinna... And begin to cascade down!

nodes.text: A 'stinking mess?' That is what you think of my traditions?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Are you really going to try to tell me that you `enjoy` the smell of entrails?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Enduring stench builds character!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh, yes. I must admit, I have difficulty understanding your ways.

nodes.text: And honestly, I'm a little lost on yours.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm kind of getting that feeling...

nodes.subtitle: A touch of magic for your holidays.

nodes.text: Welcome to a Magical Christmas episode brought to you by `Magic School: Book 1!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Welcome to a Magical Christmas episode brought to you by [b]Magic School: Book 1![/b]

nodes.text: If you haven't played `Magic School: Book 1`, get it now to enroll at SpellClaive Academy and embark on the the wildest, most magical adventure in SHS history!

$CADY, an orphan who recently learned that she has the ability to use magic, is staying at SpellClaive Academy over the holidays...
Along with her roommate, `Arinna T'Karra, the exiled Princess of the Wilde...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Along with her roommate, [b]Arinna T'Karra, the exiled Princess of the Wilde...[/b]

nodes.text: And a handful of other students and professors.
Are you ready to add a little `magic` to your holidays? You are now playing as $CADY.
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you ready to add a little [b]magic[/b] to your holidays? You are now playing as $CADY.

nodes.text: One morning, you wake up and head to the living room...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, what is that `smell?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Arinna, what is that [color=#3b78e2][i]smell?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I am preparing for the winter holidays as celebrated by my people in the Wilde!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I have tried my best to stay true to the rituals, but I have had to improvise given the constraints of your world. Would you like to join me?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I have already lit the Flames that Must Burn...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Please tell me those are candles...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Well, traditionally it `should` be a bonfire built of treasured belongings and tiny frogs, but the Headmaster requested that we use candles instead.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, traditionally it [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] be a bonfire built of treasured belongings and tiny frogs, but the Headmaster requested that we use candles instead.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, well that still doesn't explain the smell...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That is the slaughtered Gorbindal! Would you care to join me in draining the entrails of blood and fluids?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Wait a second, that smell is...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh, Gorbindals make a `most` distinctive smell, do they not?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, Gorbindals make a [color=#3b78e2][i]most[/i][/color] distinctive smell, do they not?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It's just not Rig'Rhallan without it. Besides, how else would one keep the vengeful spirit of the Rig'Rhalla beast at bay?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That's a little... Grim... Isn't it? Don't you have anything like, involving decorations or caroling?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: There `is` singing! The traditional Rig'Rhallan chant!
nodes.text_bbcode: There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] singing! The traditional Rig'Rhallan chant!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: {{ The feast of fear is near at hand! Rig'Rhalla of fangs, of slime, of spines, oh ho! {{

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: {{ Harden your hearts, prepare to stand! Rig'Rhallan of death, of fire, of tines, oh ho! {{

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It is a rough translation. I fear you have no adequate word for 'the horror of being slowly digested while still conscious' that would also rhyme with 'spines'...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Cheery.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Well, you'll have time to learn the chant later. But tell me, what human customs do you have to commemorate the dreaded duration of the frozen months?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, we usually do things that are a little... Um... Happier.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Like baking gingerbread men to leave out for Santa Claus.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh, yes! The jolly fat man who demands an offering of cookie children so he will not eat the real ones.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That's not exactly what they're for...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Well, what other cause could there be?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Y'know, just for fun.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: For fun? There is no purpose? This tradition seems meaningless.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, at least it's not smelly! Your tradition stinks like entrails!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry if I've offended your delicate human senses with a traditional offering!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry if I've offended your delicate human senses with a traditional offering!

nodes.text: Just then, the door opens.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Arinna? Is something wrong? I heard shouting.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Merely a friendly debate, brother.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I see. I should have known it would most likely be your roommate upsetting you with her troubling human ways.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Thanks. Merry Christmas to you, too, cat-boy.
Priam scowls at you.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Please attempt to behave yourself while I'm away. Arinna shouldn't be distracted with your petty squabbles when she must be thinking of her own safety.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hold up... Did you say you're leaving? Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: An ancient Rig'Rhalla tradition. Warriors often spend the night in the wilderness, honing their senses.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Now, Arinna, will you be careful while I'm away?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Brother, you worry too much. We are safe here. The threat to our security has been vanquished.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Don't get overconfident.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, come on. What could happen over the break?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: More than you think. I've been talking to Headmaster Cromwell about security... Doing some research.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Did you know a student disappeared from here twenty years ago during the winter break?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Since then, they require at least half a dozen faculty members to stay on campus at all times.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Well, then, see? The professors will look after us. Truly, Priam, do not fret so. We will take care.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Very well. Stay out of trouble, and I will see you when I return.
You shut the door behind Priam.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Now, where were we?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I believe we were in the middle of a 'friendly debate' about what we'll do about...
You have failed.

nodes.text: Mal sneaks out of bed, edging towards the door. He opens it quietly and stares into the darkness.
A huge, shadowy figure creeps down the stairs, a large bag in one hand and what looks to be a crowbar in the other.
Mal follows him down the hall and down the stairs to the living room.
Despite the Christmas lights, it's still difficult to see. Mal can only make out the figure stealing one of the gifts and putting it into a giant bag!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Oh no you don't...
Mal shoots forward to...
The room has changed! Your familiar bedroom is gone, and the room has become an ice skating rink!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Um, $CADY, is now really the time to be changing your room's appearance?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I didn't do this! Arinna, did you just change my room?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: No! Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Only a student assigned to this room would be able to alter it... Cady, are you sure you didn't think of this... Place?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Believe me, I have no idea where this is. But I did see someone... A shadow...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not imagining things?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Positive. I... Look!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What the...? Did you see her?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Something strange is happening. Rig'Rhalla, the beast of dread, is taunting us!
Snow begins to softly fall...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, did you shake your snow globe?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I have not moved it! This is most strange...
You hear a sound like soft footsteps and imprints begin appearing in the snow on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Do you see that? It's...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I believe they are footprints!
As you watch, delicate, small footprints appear one at a time in the snow in front of you!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Okay, this is definitely creepy.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I do not understand... Rig'Rhalla has tentacles, not feet...
The falling snow swirls in a chilling gust of wind. The footprints suddenly stop... And turn.
The lights flicker and then...

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: You...
The ghostly and shadowy form of a young girl stands before you. She's about your age, with dark black tears tracked down her face.
Years of honed police training kick in, and Mal easily dodges his attacker, elbowing him in the chest.
He sweeps the intruder's feet out from under him, taking him down!
In one swift motion, he has the other guy's hands behind his back and is tying them down with a thick gold cord from a Christmas decoration.
The intruder falls to the floor, struggling against the wreath's constraining wires, but the wreath holds!
He's too quick for Mal, and Mal finds himself pushed back hard into a pile of gifts.
The intruder raises his weapon and hits him! Mal winces with the first blow, but it doesn't hurt as much as it should, and the smell of peppermint perfumes the air.
As the blows continue to land unabated, Mal hears snippets of what the intruder snarls at him, phrases like 'my house,' 'and on Christmas', and 'teach you to mess with Santa Claus'...
Or at least, that's what Mal `thinks` he hears...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or at least, that's what Mal [b]thinks[/b] he hears...

nodes.text: All he knows for certain is that...
He has failed.

The ghostly and shadowy form of a young girl stands before you. She's about your age, with dark black tears tracked down her face.
A small floating `ball of flame` appears in the palm of your hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: A small floating [b]ball of flame[/b] appears in the palm of your hand!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Nice!
You hurl the ball of flame at the snow packed around you. The snow sizzles and melts...
Revealing Simon and Arinna!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: A most impressive display of magic!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, that was pretty sweet, $CADY.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Heh. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But it looks like we've still got a long way to go...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That is not all. I managed to reach a window... The snow isn't just in here. It's outside as well!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: The doors and windows are all blocked!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Then we're stuck in here...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: But at least it'll only be a matter of time before one of the professors comes looking for us.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: With a disturbance this big, I'm sure someone will notice soon. We'll just have to sit tight until help comes.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Just great! Simon, I can't believe you've gotten us into this mess. Why did you mess around with duplicating that snow globe?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I didn't want to give Arinna a gift unless I had something for you! It would just be rude!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, `that` would be rude... But burying us alive in snow is, what, proper etiquette?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] would be rude... But burying us alive in snow is, what, proper etiquette?

nodes.text: A gust of ice-cold wind suddenly blasts through the room.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That was weird... There aren't any windows open... Where did that wind come from?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh no! The... The Rig'Rhallan candles! They've been extinguished!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Um... So?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You don't understand! Rig'Rhallan is not some frivolous festivity!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It is a time of sacrifice to keep evil away!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, come on... Do you really think some big Riggy-Rooly beast is going to come charging in here just because the candles went out?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I... I suppose it is just a legend...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, it's probably just a story that only a 'Onceling' or whatever would be scared of, right?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, perhaps you are correct. There is probably nothing to fear. It is, I suppose, what you would call a superstition.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, besides, we've got a bigger problem...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Which is that we're completely snowed in!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It is quite cold here with all of this snow.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hey, I've got an idea. Maybe the snow didn't reach my room. At least it would be warm there...
Another burst of wind blows through the room, and the door to your room is swept open!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, that was a little weird...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: At least it appears there is no snow inside $CADY's room...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: One moment! Let me take my present...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, are you seriously going to bring a snow globe with us? This is the `one` room without snow.
nodes.text_bbcode: Arinna, are you seriously going to bring a snow globe with us? This is the [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] room without snow.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I will be careful! I do not want to confuse it with the other duplicates. This one is special because Simon gave it to me.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Aw...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, fine, fine! Just don't let any more snow fall!
You and your friends head into your dark bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, how about getting the lights on in here?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, just a sec...
Suddenly, everything goes dark!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, is there a blackout or something?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No, this is way darker than normal... I can't see a thing!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I heard something!
You squint at the shadows... And something moves!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I just saw someone!
You feel a shift in the room, and when the lights come back on...
The room has changed! Your familiar bedroom is gone, and the room has become an ice skating rink!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Um, $CADY, is now really the time to be changing your room's appearance?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I didn't do this! Arinna, did you just change my room?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: No! Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Only a student assigned to this room would be able to alter it... Cady, are you sure you didn't think of this... Place?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Believe me, I have no idea where this is. But I did see someone... A shadow...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not imagining things?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Positive. I... Look!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What the...? Did you see her?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Something strange is happening. Rig'Rhalla, the beast of dread, is taunting us!
Snow begins to softly fall...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, did you shake your snow globe?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I have not moved it! This is most strange...
You hear a sound like soft footsteps and imprints begin appearing in the snow on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Do you see that? It's...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I believe they are footprints!
As you watch, delicate, small footprints appear one at a time in the snow in front of you!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Okay, this is definitely creepy.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I do not understand... Rig'Rhalla has tentacles, not feet...
The falling snow swirls in a chilling gust of wind. The footprints suddenly stop... And turn.
The lights flicker and then...

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: You...
The ghostly and shadowy form of a young girl stands before you. She's about your age, with dark black tears tracked down her face.
There is a small disturbance in the air over your palm, as if the air itself had grown thick, and then `NOTHING...`
nodes.text_bbcode: There is a small disturbance in the air over your palm, as if the air itself had grown thick, and then [b]NOTHING...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Come on!
Simon continues to struggle!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon!
The ghost turns away from Simon and looks at Arinna again.
Or more specifically, what Arinna is holding!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: My snow globe! It is somehow still intact...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Perhaps because it was the original snow globe and not a duplicate...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Wait a second... This place... It's exactly like the inside of the snow globe!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Simon, I'm starting to think there was more magic on that snow globe than you realized...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I'm a secure enough guy to admit that you may be right...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, give me your snow globe! I've got an idea!
Arinna hands you the snow globe, and the ghost's eyes snap to you.
A small floating `ball of flame` appears in the palm of your hand!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Take that!
You hurl the ball of flame at the girl! She jumps back before it hits her, releasing Simon.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Thanks, $CADY.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon! Are you okay?
Arinna runs to Simon, and the ghost's blank, dark eyes follow her...
